items.source: A specialization of GenericConversionService configured by default with converters appropriate for most environments.
items.translation: 一个默认配置的 `GenericConversionService` 特化类，其中包含适用于大多数环境的转换器。

items.source: Return the ConfigurableConversionService used when performing type conversions on properties.
items.translation: 返回在属性上执行类型转换时使用的ConfigurableConversionService。

items.source: Set the ConfigurableConversionService to be used when performing type conversions on properties.
items.translation: 将 `ConfigurableConversionService` 设置为在执行属性类型转换时使用的服务。
`org.springframework.core.convert.support` 包中 `ConfigurableConversionService` 的用法
`org.springframework.core.env` 包中 `ConfigurableConversionService`接口的用法

items.source: A ConversionService implementation designed to be configured as a FormatterRegistry.
items.translation: 一个设计为可配置为FormatterRegistry的ConversionService实现。

items.source: Base ConversionService implementation suitable for use in most environments.
items.translation: 适用于大多数环境的 Base ConversionService 实现。

items.source: A specialization of FormattingConversionService configured by default with converters and formatters appropriate for most applications.
items.translation: 一个默认配置了适用于大多数应用程序的转换器和格式化器的FormattingConversionService 的特化版本。

items.source: Default implementation of the type conversion system.
items.translation: 类型转换系统的默认实现。

items.source:
Spring's environment abstraction consisting of bean definition
profile and hierarchical property source support.
items.translation: Spring 的环境抽象由 Bean 定义配置文件和分层属性源支持组成。

items.source:
Support classes for the formatting package,
providing common implementations as well as adapters.
items.translation: 格式化包的支持类，提供通用实现以及适配器。
